title: The Dog Night, 2010
logline: Eleven years. The first Dog Night after the sabbatical. He carries the dog both ways.

panels.composition: The dumpster, night, the bulb. WOOD arriving carrying BARNABY. Setting him down on the gravel gently.

image.prompt: a man gently setting an old dog down on gravel behind a bowling alley at night under a bulb, muddy watercolor, no words

panels.composition: The dog standing. Looking at the dumpster. Sitting.

image.prompt: close-up of an old dog looking at a rusted dumpster and then sitting, no words

panels.composition: Wood on the gravel beside him. His hand on the dog. Both looking at nothing in particular.

image.prompt: a man sitting on gravel with his hand resting on an old dog beside him, both looking at nothing, bulb light, no words

panels.composition: Walking away, the dog carried. The sign: SMALL WOOD LANES, and for the first time one letter is dark. The S.
props: neon with the first letter dark

image.prompt: a man carrying an old dog away beneath a bowling-alley neon sign where the first letter has gone dark, night, watercolor, no words
image.notes: The first dead letter: the S. 'Lanes' 2009 had the L flicker; this year one is fully out. Track the sign from here.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Carried both ways. The first letter dies on the sign.
